title: Dermalogica Hydro Masque Exfoliant Review: Bamboo and Snow Mushroom, How to Use It
description:
Dermalogica Hydro Masque Exfoliant: a five-minute masque that exfoliates with bamboo and hydrates with snow mushroom, for luminous, healthy-looking skin.

We earn a commission if you buy through our link.

• Five-minute masque that exfoliates and hydrates (50 ml)
• Exfoliating bamboo primes skin for hydration
• Snow mushroom hydrates; jojoba esters and amino acids from sugar beets help strengthen the moisture barrier
• Cucumber extract gives a soothing finish
• Apply generously to cleansed face and neck, avoid eyes, massage until the spheres disappear, leave 3-5 minutes, rinse, follow with moisturizer; once or twice a week
